mechanism: Estradiol may reduce the diuretic and natriuretic efficacy of bumetanide through sodium retention and fluid retention effects, while bumetanide increases risk of hypokalemia which estradiol can potentiate.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) regularly and blood pressure; consider potassium supplementation or potassium-sparing agent if needed; counsel patient on signs of hypokalemia.
